Source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map?bbox=-74.009,40.714,-74.005,40.717
Retrieved: 2026-11-26
Area: Lower Manhattan, New York City, USA.
Projection origin: latitude 40.7155, longitude -74.007.
The raw extract is retained as lower_manhattan.osm.
Content/CityData/lower_manhattan.json is a derived ODbL database.

Approximation: buildings are axis-aligned envelopes rendered with generic existing
architecture. Missing height uses building:levels * 3 m or a 9 m default.
Multipolygon relations, terrain elevation, bridges, tunnels and exact facades are
not reconstructed. A 20 m launch clearance removes overlapping building envelopes.
This is a real-map-derived research scene, not a surveyed reconstruction.
